description:
We are a passionate and creative team interested in space technology, innovation, and healthcare. Our project focuses on developing Health Care Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions, aimed at monitoring astronauts' health conditions and supporting their well-being during space travel. 

We welcome team members with skills in programming, software development, UI/UX design, healthcare research, data analysis, and creative problem-solving.
summary: Astrocare is an astronaut health monitoring software system designed to submit astronauts during long duration Space missions.It monitor important health indicator such as heart rate,blood oxygen levels,sleep patterns and physical activity.The system collects and analysis health data and displays the results through the interactive dashboard with graphs and notification.It helps identify unusual health changes and allows astronauts to review their health status over time.
details:
Astrocare is a software based astronaut health monitoring system designed to help monitor astronauts health during long duration Space mission.
This system focus on 4 major health indicators :heart rate , blood oxygen saturation,sleep duration and physical activity.It collect health information and process the readings to identify unusual changes.
